title: MANAGED PCM TO SPECIFIC DAC / ADVANCED DSP
verdict: IN_PROGRESS_CORRECTIVE — complete capture coverage, single resampler quality authority, passive diagnostic primitive, atomic measurement fence, both-side PCM continuity evidence and a diagnostic-free productive install are verified. The session diagnostic capture remains ISOLATED (PlaybackService converges out-of-band playback). Dither/FIR blocked; physical DAC NOT_RUN. F06 stays READY.

plan_rules: specific selected device + one current ALSA playback binding only
binding must belong to the selected device and be currently available
stale selection revision is a typed refusal
output rate = source rate unless the compiled plan changes rate
output channels = source channels unless the plan changes channels
terminal container only from proven current capability
deterministic execution id over device/binding/selection/processing facts
no Direct OutputPlan reuse and no allow_processing flag

managed_pcm.no_fallback: a missing/unavailable device or a rejected load raises a typed ManagedPcmExecutionError and STOPS; the default output is never used and no identity claim is returned

runtime_convergence.defect: CI segfault: host loss processed during characterization ran convergence inline on the worker and created the Qt backend re-entrantly
runtime_convergence.fix: convergence is armed on the OWNER with a short QTimer (5 ms), outside the current processEvents stack; worker callers reach the owner via a dedicated executor. This removes the re-entrant Qt activation segfault.
runtime_convergence.proof: host-dead managed prepare fails typed, releases cleanly; full suite green
